pictures.name: MBL1-Cold-Tent
pictures.prompt: Dawn inside a leather army tent at the Roman frontier, around 170 AD. Emperor Marcus Aurelius, about fifty, curly greying hair and a full curly beard, lies under heavy wool blankets and furs on a camp bed, eyes open, clearly not wanting to get up, his breath visible in the cold. Grey-blue light at the tent flap, a cold brazier, his purple-edged cloak hanging on a stand. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
